description.narrative: The development objectives of the Socio-Economic Resilience Strengthening Project for Tajikistan are to strengthen participatory local governance, improve the quality of local infrastructure, both in targeted communities, and increase extracurricular or livelihood opportunities for youth. The project comprises of three components. The first component, inclusive local development initiatives will strengthen the capacity of Jamoat administrations and community-level institutions, including mahalla committees, to engage with citizens and deliver services efficiently, fairly, and in a way that responds to the needs of citizens, including youth and women. It consists of following sub-components: (i) subgrants for local development initiatives; (ii) community and youth mobilization, social accountability, and local governance capacity building; and (iii) refurbishment of youth facilities. The second component, youth inclusion and livelihoods will offer two sets of interrelated activities for disadvantaged and inactive young men and women aged 16 to 30 to increase their overall resilience to risks of exclusion, inactivity, and disaffection. It consists of following sub-components: (i) youth-inclusive services; and (ii) youth livelihoods. The third component, project management and monitoring and evaluation will provide support for: (i) project management activities, including overall coordination and supervision of project implementation, project audits, and financing of incremental operating costs, (ii) project monitoring and evaluation activities, project transparency, and citizen feedback, and (iii) manage a beneficiary feedback mechanism (BFM), including a grievance redress mechanism (GRM).

condition.narrative: Schedule 2, Section I.A.2The Recipient shall cause the Project Implementing Entity to establish not later than three (3) monthsafter the Effective Date and thereafter maintain, throughout the implementation of the Project, a Project management team withadequate staff and resources acceptable to the Association. The Project management team should include, inter alia, a Projectcoordinator, a procurement specialist, a financial management specialist, a head engineer, environmental and social safeguardspecialists, youth inclusion and livelihood specialists CDD specialists, and social accountability specialists.

Schedule 2, Section I.A.3The Recipient shall cause the Project Implementing Entity to carry out the Project in accordance with theProject Manuals, satisfactory to the Association. Except as the Association shall otherwise agree in writing, the Recipient shallcause the Project Implementing Entity not to amend, waive, suspend, or abrogate any of the provisions of the Project Manualswithout the Association's prior written agreement. In case of any inconsistency between any of the provisions of the ProjectManuals and those of this Agreement, the provisions of this Agreement shall prevail.

Schedule 2, Section I.A.4The Recipient shall cause the Project Implementation Entity to ensure provision of technical support (i)of the selected TFPs for purposes of carrying out activities under Part 1 of the Project; and (ii) of the selected IPs for purposesof carrying out activities under Part 2 of the Project, as set forth in this Agreement and the Project Manuals.

Schedule 2, Section I.A.6The Recipient shall cause the Project Implementation Entity to establish, not later than 60 days afterthe Effective Date, an automated accounting information system, satisfactory to the Association, for recording Project records andgeneration of Project financial statements.
